articles.title: Operational Framework Finalised for India's Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS)
articles.summary: The Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) releases key operational guidelines for the domestic compliance carbon market under CCTS.
prelims: CCTS was notified under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001.
Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) acts as the administrator for the market framework.
Greenhouse Gas Emission Intensity targets are assigned to obligated entities to issue Carbon Credit Certificates (CCCs).
articles.mains: Examine how the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS) balances industrial growth with India's Panchamrit climate commitments under the UNFCCC.

articles.title: Implementation Progress of the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA)
articles.summary: India and European Free Trade Association (EFTA) nations advance tariff rationalisation and $100 billion investment targets.
prelims: EFTA member countries are Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, and Switzerland.
First FTA signed by India featuring a legally binding commitment of $100 billion in FDI over 15 years.
Key sectors covered include pharmaceuticals, precision machinery, and renewable technology transfer.
articles.mains: Analyze the significance of investment-linked free trade agreements for enhancing India's manufacturing competitiveness and global supply chain integration.

articles.title: Draft National Guidelines on Ethical Integration of AI in Public Service Delivery
articles.summary: MeitY issues comprehensive guidelines prioritizing algorithmic transparency, data privacy, and non-discrimination in AI public deployment.
prelims: Formulated under the operational aegis of the IndiaAI Mission.
Mandates Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) architecture for welfare scheme beneficiary selection.
Aligns strictly with provisions of the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023.
articles.mains: Discuss the ethical challenges of adopting Artificial Intelligence in public governance and suggest safeguards to protect civil liberties.

articles.title: Dual-Frequency Earth Observation: ISRO-NASA NISAR Mission Advances Pre-Launch Workflows
articles.summary: The joint ISRO-NASA Earth-observing satellite NISAR completes crucial integration testing for dual-frequency radar land mapping.
prelims: NISAR utilizes both L-band (NASA) and S-band (ISRO) Synthetic Aperture Radars (SAR).
It will map the entire globe's land and ice masses every 12 days to monitor crustal deformation and natural hazards.
Configuration allows for surface movement measurements down to fractions of an inch.
articles.mains: Highlight the applications of dual-frequency synthetic aperture radar technology in disaster management and climate resilience planning in India.

articles.title: Strengthening Wetlands along the Central Asian Flyway (CAF) Action Plan
articles.summary: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change scales up wetland restoration to protect migratory birds along the CAF.
prelims: Central Asian Flyway covers 30 countries, extending from Arctic breeding grounds to South Asian wintering grounds.
India hosts over 90% of the migratory bird species traversing the Central Asian Flyway route.
Initiative operates under the aegis of the Convention on the Conservation of Migratory Species of Wild Animals (CMS / Bonn Convention).
articles.mains: Evaluate the role of transboundary conservation initiatives and Ramsar site management in safeguarding migratory avian species.
